question: Which will occur next with respect to the FDA's review of deramiocel for muscular dystrophy?

calls.reasoning: PDUFA date is Nov 22, 2026 (extended from Aug 22 after a major amendment), inside the window, so an FDA action by then is the default (~85%); residual for missed date/further delay/second AdCom. Conditional on action, rejection is favored: July 2026 AdCom voted 9-3 against effectiveness (cardiomyopathy), FDA reviewers called the PUL endpoint not significant/hard to interpret, H.C. Wainwright expects rejection, stock down ~80% YTD. Upside: committee called upper-limb evidence directionally supportive, positive 24-month OLE data, FDA cited unmet need, rare-disease flexibility. No human prediction market found (Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold searched).
calls.dossier:
- History (PPMD summary): BLA accepted Mar 2025 with priority review; CRL Jul 2025 (more efficacy data + CMC clarifications); HOPE-3 Phase 3 topline Dec 2025; FDA lifted CRL Mar 10 2026, Class 2 resubmission, PDUFA Aug 22 2026.
- Jul 29-30 2026 (Fierce/BioSpace/STAT): CTGTAC advisory committee voted 3 yes / 9 no on effectiveness for DMD cardiomyopathy; meeting marked by statistical dispute. On upper-limb function there was no vote; feedback described as 'directionally supportive', but one expert said 'very hard to say there is a real effect'. FDA briefing said trial 'failed to show a statistically significant or clinically meaningful effect' on prespecified upper-limb endpoint; company says HOPE-3 met primary PUL v2.0 endpoint (54% slowing) and LVEF secondary (91% slowing).
- Aug 24 2026 (CGTLive/Capricor 8-K): CBER accepted major amendment (24-month OLE data, robustness analyses, refined indication = upper-limb function); PDUFA extended 3 months to Nov 22, 2026 (a Sunday). FDA cited significant unmet need.
- Oct 5 2026: positive OLE upper-limb data presented at World Muscle Society (placebo crossovers slowed decline 76% vs prior year).
- Oct 21 2026 (Stocktwits): CAPR down 11% that day, ~38% in October, ~80% YTD. H.C. Wainwright sees rejection as more likely; Roth sees possible second AdCom on upper-limb. 4 Buy / 6 Hold among 10 analysts.
- A partnership agreement reportedly has a termination provision if no approval by Dec 31 2026 (Red Flag Research substack).
- Status quo: BLA under review, no action yet; no announced second AdCom, no announced further delay found as of Oct 28.
- Resolution: next of approval (any, incl. accelerated) / new CRL occurring after Oct 31 2026; 'Neither' if none before Nov 23 2026. Event window: Nov 1 2026 -> Nov 22 2026; as of Oct 28 0% elapsed. PDUFA falls on last day of window (Sunday) — FDA may act Fri Nov 20 or on the date; public announcement could slip to Mon Nov 23.
- Searched, not found: any human prediction market (Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold); any news after Oct 21 on late-cycle meeting outcome or labeling discussions.

calls.dossier:
- PDUFA target action date for deramiocel BLA (DMD) is Nov 22, 2026 (a Sunday), extended from Aug 22, 2026 after FDA accepted a major amendment (24-month HOPE-3 OLE data, robustness analyses, refined indication: upper-limb function preservation) (CGTLive / Capricor PR, Aug 2026).
- History: BLA accepted Mar 2025 with priority review; CRL July 2025 citing need for additional efficacy data and CMC clarification; Dec 2025 HOPE-3 topline reported as meeting primary endpoint PUL v2.0 and key secondary LVEF; Mar 2026 FDA set Aug 22, 2026 PDUFA on Class 2 resubmission (Parent Project MD).
- July 29, 2026 CTGTAC advisory committee voted 9-3 that evidence did not support effectiveness for DMD cardiomyopathy; panel discussion on upper-limb function described by company as directionally supportive (Capricor PR; BioPharma Dive; BioSpace called meeting chaotic).
- Earlier, FDA had cancelled a planned AdComm reportedly due to CBER director Vinay Prasad's negative view of deramiocel (BioPharma Dive citing STAT, 2025).
- STAT (Feuerstein, Aug 20, 2026): headline says the treatment is 'heading for an FDA rejection'; calls OLE submission 'a stall tactic', says a new randomized trial is the only viable path.
- Oct 5, 2026: Capricor presented OLE data at World Muscle Society - placebo crossovers had 76% slower upper-limb decline vs their own prior year.
- Oct 21, 2026 (Stocktwits): CAPR fell 11% that day, ~38% for October, ~80% YTD; H.C. Wainwright sees small chance of approval, CRL more likely; Roth suggested a second FDA panel on upper-limb could occur; 4 of 10 analysts Buy.
- Status quo: no approval; a decision (approval or CRL) is due by Nov 22. FDA now publicly releases CRLs.
- Resolves off the next event (approval incl. accelerated, or a new CRL) occurring after Oct 31, 2026; expanded access/trial permission does not count.
- Event window: Nov 1, 2026 -> Nov 22, 2026 (resolution Nov 23); as of Oct 28, 2026 0% elapsed. An action taken Oct 29-31 would precede the window.
- Base-rate notes: FDA meets ~90%+ of PDUFA goals overall, though CBER has missed several dates in 2025-26 era; negative-AdComm applications get approved in a minority of cases overall, with DMD a known exception area (e.g., eteplirsen, Elevidys accelerated).
- Searched but not found: any report of labeling discussions, late-cycle meeting outcome, or scheduled second AdComm; any Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market on the Nov 2026 decision (only an old Polymarket market for Aug 31, 2025).

calls.reasoning: PDUFA goal date Nov 22, 2026 (Sunday) after 3-month major-amendment extension falls on the last day of the Nov 1-22 window, so an FDA action inside the window is the default (~86%); residual covers missed CBER goal dates, a second AdCom, or a CRL issued Oct 29-31 before the window. Conditional on action, CRL favored ~79%: prior CRL (Jul 2025), 9-3 negative AdCom with critical FDA briefing on the PUL endpoint, STAT and HCW expecting rejection, stock -80% YTD. Upside: primary PUL v2.0 met, 'directionally supportive' panel view on upper limb, FDA extended rather than rejected in August, positive OLE data, DMD regulatory flexibility, accelerated approval counts. calls.reconciliation: All three runs agreed on the facts (PDUFA Nov 22, 2026; 9-3 negative AdCom; amendment narrowing to upper limb; HCW expecting CRL; stock collapse; no market). Disagreement was judgment only: P(approval|action) 0.12-0.35 and P(no action in window) 0.10-0.15. Three searches checked for any news after Oct 21 (late-cycle meeting outcome, second AdCom, early CRL, further extension): nothing new found; PDUFA still Nov 22. I take a reading between Run 3 and Runs 1-2: the extension instead of an August CRL and DMD flexibility keep approval nontrivial, but the panel vote, FDA briefing and market signal make a CRL the clear favorite.
